### Quillstep Black Friday Campaign Recap (20–29 Nov 2026)

The Black Friday campaign (`Quillstep - Black Friday 2026 - UK Sign-ups`, ID: `ysg0s`) has completed its full flight and all ad groups have been paused.

#### Overall Totals
* **Total Spend:** $545.32 USD (out of $550.00 budget)
* **Total Impressions:** 477,920
* **Total Link Clicks:** 157 (avg. CPC: $3.47)
* **Total Engagements:** 3,171 (including 84 likes)

---

#### Performance Breakdown by Ad Group (Line Item)

| Ad Group | ID | Goal | Status | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Engagements |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **UK - DB & Software Dev - LINK_CLICKS** | `ag0ij` | `LINK_CLICKS` | Completed / Paused | $270.85 | 212,012 | 82 | 1,442 |
| **UK - DB & Migration Keywords - SITE_VISITS** | `vfiff` | `SITE_VISITS` | Completed / Paused | $251.49 | 169,142 | 74 | 1,144 |
| **UK - Desktop Software Dev & DB - LINK_CLICKS** | `lcbjw` | `LINK_CLICKS` | Paused Early (Day 3) | $22.98 | 32,587 | 1 | 198 |
| **UK - Software Dev & Desktop - SITE_VISITS** | `5p62p` | `SITE_VISITS` | Paused Early (Day 2) | $0.00 | 64,179 | 0 | 387 |
| **Total** | | | | **$545.32** | **477,920** | **157** | **3,171** |

---

#### Flight Management & Optimization Notes
* **Targeting:** All ad groups targeted the United Kingdom (`LOCATION: GB`) combined with `Technology / Software Development` interest and high-intent database/migration keywords (`postgres`, `postgresql`, `mysql`, `schema migration`, `database migration`, `alter table`, `devops`, `prisma`, `flyway`, `liquibase`).
* **Optimization Adjustments:** 
  * Ad groups restricted to Desktop-only (`5p62p` and `lcbjw`) showed weak click-through efficiency compared to cross-platform keyword + developer interest ad groups (`vfiff` and `ag0ij`) and were paused early in the flight.
  * Budget was reallocated to `vfiff` (`SITE_VISITS`) and `ag0ij` (`LINK_CLICKS`), where all 4 approved posts delivered steady traffic to `https://quillstep.co.uk/black-friday` while pacing cleanly within the $550.00 cap through midnight on Sunday 29 November.
